description: Year 1 of each club (D78): its own course set, easiest first. Tiny Cubs 2-3: familiar things to recognise, short lessons and nursery rhymes. Little Cubs 4-5: letters, counting to 20, body parts with what they do, vegetables. Big Cubs 6-8: named species of birds and flowers, and moral stories. A course listed here reaches only children enrolled in that club's program; a published course listed nowhere reaches nobody and is logged at start-up. Seeded only while program_course is empty; admins change programs in the admin area.
